anomalies.description: Player #23 (MIN, green jersey) and player #8 (WPG, white/blue jersey) engage in a physical confrontation near the boards; #23 appears to deliver a check or shove while #8 is off-balance, leading to contact that results in #8 falling in subsequent frames.; Player #9 (Winnipeg, white jersey) and player #23 (Minnesota, green jersey) engage in a physical confrontation along the boards: #23 delivers a forceful check/shoulder into #9, who is pinned against the boards; #23 then appears to deliver additional contact or a shove while #9 is off-balance and unable to defend himself, leading directly to #9 falling to the ice in subsequent frames.

After being driven into the boards and losing balance, player #9 is in a vulnerable, off-balance position; player #23 continues physical engagement (e.g., pushing, shoving, or striking while #9 is unable to effectively defend), constituting an attack on a helpless victim.

Two players engage in sustained physical combat along the boards: the green-jerseyed player (No. 23) initiates contact, drives the blue-jerseyed player (No. 9) into the boards, and continues to push/hold him while both struggle for position and control; the interaction includes grappling, shoving, and body-checking against the boards without separation until the blue player falls at ~23.5s.

Multiple players from both teams (Winnipeg Jets in white/blue and Minnesota Wild in green) engage in a large-scale on-ice brawl near the boards, involving punching, grappling, and shoving; referees intervene to separate combatants throughout the sequence.

A chaotic group confrontation erupts involving numerous players from both benches converging at the boards, with multiple simultaneous physical altercations, sticks raised, and officials struggling to regain control—constituting collective violent unrest beyond a simple two-person fight.

Multiple players from both teams (Winnipeg Jets in white/blue and Minnesota Wild in green) are engaged in a large-scale on-ice brawl near the bench, involving shoving, grappling, helmet pulling, and stick挥舞; referees are attempting to separate them.

Multiple players from Winnipeg (white/blue jerseys) and Minnesota (green jerseys) are engaged in a multi-person on-ice altercation, involving shoving, grabbing, and close physical contact; referees actively intervene to separate the groups throughout the sequence.
